# UnVale Blog

> > A creative community blog focused on original character creation, world-building, and collaborative storytelling for artists and writers.

UnVale is a platform for creators to develop and share original characters (OCs), participate in community events like the Original Creations Awards, and engage with collaborative roleplay worlds. The blog provides tutorials, design tips, writing guides, and hosts regular creative challenges like #DailyDoodle.

## Key Topics

- Original Characters (OCs)
- Character Design
- Creative Writing
- World-Building
- DailyDoodle Art Prompts
- Community Events
- Character Development
- Collaborative Worlds
- Original Creations Awards
- Adoptable Characters
- Character Aesthetics
- D&D Character Design
- Villain Design
- Hero Design
- Story Writing Tips

## Character Creation Guides

- [How to Create Your First Original Character](https://blog.unvale.io/how-to-create-your-first-original-character): Beginner guide to creating your first OC on Unvale platform
- [All About Adoptable Characters](https://blog.unvale.io/all-about-adoptable-characters): Guide to adoptable characters in artistic communities and on Unvale
- [Common Strengths and Weakness to Give your OCs!](https://blog.unvale.io/common-strengths-and-weakness-to-give-your-ocs): Writing guide for developing character traits and flaws for OCs

## Character Design Tips

- [Tips for Designing an Appealing Villain OC!](https://blog.unvale.io/tips-for-designing-a-villain-oc): Character design tips for creating compelling villain OCs
- [Tips for Designing a Hero OC!](https://blog.unvale.io/tips-for-designing-a-hero-oc): Character design guide for creating hero OCs with iconic aesthetics
- [Tips for Designing Your DND OC Based on Their Class!](https://blog.unvale.io/tips-for-designing-your-dnd-oc-based-on-their-class): D&D character design guide based on class for TTRPG players
- [Tips for Designing an Elf OC!](https://blog.unvale.io/tips-for-designing-an-elf-oc): Fantasy character design guide for creating elf OCs

## Creative Writing & Storytelling

- [Ways to Start a Story](https://blog.unvale.io/ways-to-start-a-story): Writing tips for crafting compelling story openings and hooks
- [World Building Using Genres](https://blog.unvale.io/world-building-using-genres): Creative writing guide on using genre expectations for world-building
- [Tips for Writing a Duo/Pair or Trio Dynamics in your Stories](https://blog.unvale.io/tips-for-writing-a-duo-pair-or-trio-dynamics-in-your-stories): Writing guide for developing duo and trio character relationships

## Community Events & Spotlights

- [The 2025 Original Creations Awards — Recap!](https://blog.unvale.io/the-2025-original-creations-awards-recap): Recap of 2025 Original Creations Awards livestream event on Unvale
